import numpy as np

def cross_entropy(true_probs, predicted_probs):
    q_clipped = np.clip(predicted_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    ce = -np.sum(true_probs * np.log2(q_clipped))
    return ce

def binary_cross_entropy(true_labels, predictions):
    p_clipped = np.clip(predictions, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    bce = -(true_labels * np.log(p_clipped) + (1 - true_labels) * np.log(1 - p_clipped))
    return np.mean(bce)

def categorical_cross_entropy(one_hot_true, predictions):
    p_clipped = np.clip(predictions, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    return -np.sum(one_hot_true * np.log(p_clipped))

true = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0])
pred = np.array([0.7, 0.2, 0.1])
print(f"Cross-entropy: {cross_entropy(true, pred):.4f}")

labels = np.array([1, 0, 1, 1])
preds = np.array([0.9, 0.1, 0.8, 0.4])
print(f"Binary CE: {binary_cross_entropy(labels, preds):.4f}")
